Frequently Asked Questions

What print finishes and paper stocks are available?

We stock paper weights from 80 GSM bond to 400 GSM luxury cardstock, with finishes including thermal matte lamination, gloss lamination, spot UV, embossed textures, and metallic foil stamping.

What is 2400 DPI printing and why does it matter?

DPI stands for Dots Per Inch. Standard printing is 300-600 DPI, whereas 2400 DPI digital press printing delivers photographic sharpness, eliminating pixelation on fine text and intricate logos.

Can you help with layout design before printing?

Yes, our creative team assists with file preparation, color corrections, bleed margins, and pre-flight proofing to ensure flawless print results.
